prompts: Edit target: the attached generated locomotion sheet. This is a formatting and transparency correction. Deliver ONLY WALK frames, no running poses. EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows (8 total sprites) on a genuinely transparent alpha background. TOP ROW 4 frames: right-foot heel contact; right-foot flat left heel lift; left knee passing right leg; left foot reaching forward. BOTTOM ROW 4 frames: left-foot heel contact; left-foot flat right heel lift; right knee passing left leg; right foot reaching forward. Uniform body proportions and size, pelvis centered in each cell, both rows same scale and same foot baseline. SIDE VIEW facing right throughout, exact character rendering of attached reference, white top, black skirt/shorts, stockings, red boots/gloves. Arms counter swing smoothly, hair small consistent motion. Not eight same extended leg poses. Maintain anatomical height; no chest/face/hip size changes. NO background color, NO text, NO numbers, no decorations. Do not modify the neutral reference design.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided 4-column 2-row sprite sheet: REMOVE ONLY THE BROWN BACKGROUND. Output genuinely transparent RGBA alpha background, alpha zero everywhere outside each of the eight complete characters and in gaps between limbs. Keep the eight existing characters, their faces, clothes, hair, poses, dimensions, colors, outlines, cell arrangement and canvas size UNCHANGED. Do not add or redraw poses. No opaque brown, white, black, gradient or checkerboard background. Preserve the white tank tops and skin; those are not background.
